remarks: Tucked away at the end of a private cul-de-sac in Darien's highly coveted Delafield Island, this custom 5BR, 4.5BA Colonial offers 5,475 sq. ft. of luxury living on over one acre. Built by a renowned high-end homebuilder, this home combines in-town convenience with the privacy of a resort-style backyard featuring a heated free-form infinity saltwater pool, spa, waterfall, and freestanding stone fireplace.  Inside, the chef's kitchen is equipped with two Sub-Zero refrigerator/freezer units, Viking range, quartz countertops, Miele dishwasher, large walk-in pantry, Rohl faucets, and a triple filtration water system. The sunlit entryway opens to a spacious living room with fireplace and a formal dining room that seats 12, perfect for entertaining.  Luxury details include Brazilian cherry floors, extensive millwork and wainscoting, transom windows, and a music system with indoor/outdoor zones. The primary suite features dual closets, fireplace, French doors to a private deck, and a marble bath with steam shower and jetted tub.  more....
